_comment: Canonical brand configuration consumed by the Brand Specialist agent. Copy to global/config/brand-dna.json and fill in your brand. Capsule-level brand files may declare {"inherits_from": "global/config/brand-dna.json"} and override sections.

brand.name: Your Brand
brand.tagline: One line on what the brand promises
tone_rules: No hype words unless the claim is verifiable

colors.usage_notes: Accent for CTAs only; keep body text on background at WCAG AA contrast or better
